bagPolicy.summary: Small personal bags and backpacks are allowed at the UC Berkeley Greek Theatre. The policy encourages bringing reusable water bottles.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: Parking is very limited around the Greek Theatre, and it's recommended to use public transportation, biking, or carpooling. UC Berkeley lots near the venue open at 5:00pm, accept credit cards only, and have limited spots. Disabled parking is available at Upper Hearst parking garage.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in UC Berkeley Greek Theatre's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: The Greek Theatre offers a variety of food concessions throughout the venue, featuring an array of snacks and specialty drinks. Visitors can enjoy a wide selection of refreshments during events.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: UC Berkeley Greek Theatre strive to maintain WCAG 2.1 Level AA compliance, and to increase the accessibility of our digital content for all.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in UC Berkeley Greek Theatre's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: A: The box office opens 2 hours prior to each show and is located at the North Gate of the venue. Ticket sales and will call pickup are available 2 hours prior to showtime.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at UC Berkeley Greek Theatre. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
